text: 1. Blending Rituals allows you to add Blending Affixes to any Belt. By blending Aromatic Materials according to specific recipes, you can obtain the following types of Blending Affixes: Medium Talents, Core Talents, and Aromatic Talents.

2. Blending can be performed on crafted gear and gear that has undergone Dream Interpretation, Corrosion, or Branding. Gear with Blending Affixes can still be used for crafting, Dream Interpretation, Corrosion, and Branding, depending on its gear type.
3. Once Blending starts, it cannot be interrupted. Abandoning the Blending process will still consume the Aromatic Materials used.
